newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: ERPM may cease operations in near future.
newsitem.headline: ERPM may cease operations in near future.

text.p: East Rand Proprietary Mines Ltd said on Thursday the current low gold price and lower than expected underground yields created a strong possibility that the gold mine could cease operations in the near future.
The mine, managed by Randgold and Exploration Co Ltd, said it was operating at a loss with no reasonable possibility of generating profits in the foreseeable future.
"Whilst management has made certain proposals to government and discussions are taking place, there remains a strong possibility of ceasing operations in the near future," it said.
The company advised shareholders to exercise caution when dealing in their shares until a further announcement is made.
Earlier this month Randgold announced it would stop operations at ERPM's Benoni Gold Mining Co division as soon as possible due to the slide in the gold price.
In early July the bullion price fell to 12-year lows. It was last bid in London at $321.90 an ounce.
ERPM made a pre-capex net loss of 11.14 million rand in the March quarter compared to 18.68 million rand profit in the preceding quarter.
Randgold is due to announce June quarter results on Monday.
